title: Pentagon Extends National Guard Deployment in Washington, D.C. Through January 2029
detail: The Department of Defense confirmed on July 14, 2026 that it has extended the National Guard deployment in Washington, D.C. through January 20, 2029 — effectively the remainder of President Trump's current term, 'or until terminated by the President.' The deployment began in August 2025 after Trump declared a crime emergency in the capital and signed an executive order authorizing the mission. More than 5,000 troops from over 20 states are now stationed in the city as part of a 'summer surge' of federal law enforcement announced in May. D.C. leaders continued to oppose the extension, arguing the troops are unnecessary, untrained for civilian policing, and harmful to local businesses.

media.caption: Pentagon confirms National Guard mission in D.C. extended through January 2029
